info.about: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair is a 2012 visual novel developed by Spike Chunsoft. It is the second game in the Danganronpa franchise following Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc (2010).
info.trivia: The trials are argued in real time, and you shoot down testimony with literal ammunition.
info.why: Vita physical copies are increasingly hard to find complete, and the series has a devoted following.
